licenses.text:
Benito Pérez Galdós, Saragossa, translated by Minna Caroline Smith.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/benito-perez-galdos/saragossa/minna-caroline-smith

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Benito Pérez Galdós, the author, died 1920 (Translation's first publication (1899, translator Minna Caroline Smith); original Spanish 1874 (Spain uses life+80, so all gates still pass)).
- Minna Caroline Smith, the translator, died 1929.

First publication of the text used: 1899 (SE colophon: 'Saragossa was published in 1874 by Benito Pérez Galdós. It was translated from Spanish in 1899 by Minna Caroline Smith').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1899, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1994.
- Country of origin (Translation's first publication (1899, translator Minna Caroline Smith); original Spanish 1874 (Spain uses life+80, so all gates still pass)): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1929, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 2000.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: original 1874, Smith translation 1899; no editor/introducer mentioned
- Wikidata Q189869 (Benito Pérez Galdós, 'Spanish realist novelist 1843-1920'), P570 = 1920-01-04
- Wikidata Q63619199 (Minna Caroline Smith, 1860-1929), P570 = 1929-01-01 (refs: Open Library, Project Gutenberg); no English Wikipedia article, single human match for the exact name
